description: The Visible and Infra-Red Radiometer (VIRR) on FY-3C is a 10-channel optical and infrared imaging radiometer observing from 0.44 to 12.0 µm. It provides operational multispectral measurements for cloud detection, sea surface temperature, snow and ice extent, and vegetation indices.
facility_description: FengYun-3C is China’s morning-orbit polar-orbiting meteorological satellite in the FY-3 series, launched in September 2013 and operated by the National Satellite Meteorological Center (NSMC) of the China Meteorological Administration (CMA).
notes: FY-3C VIRR filter spectral response data are distributed via the NSMC GSICS portal (http://gsics.nsmc.org.cn/portal/en/fycv/srf.html). Note that NJM catalogs 7 bands for FY3C-VIRR (CH01, CH02, CH06, CH07, CH08, CH09, CH10). NSMC asserts Copyright © NSMC(NCSW).
